actions.label: Wifi
actions.command: sh -c '[[ $SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE == true ]] && nmcli radio wifi on || nmcli radio wifi off'
actions.update-command: sh -c '[[ $(nmcli r wifi) == "enabled" ]] && echo true || echo false'

actions.label: BT
actions.command: sh -c '[[ $SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE == true ]] && rfkill unblock bluetooth || rfkill block bluetooth'
actions.update-command: sh -c "rfkill list bluetooth | grep -q "Soft blocked: no" && echo true || echo false"

actions.label: Mic
actions.command: sh -c '[[ $SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE == true ]] && pactl set-source-mute @DEFAULT_SOURCE@ 0 || pactl set-source-mute @DEFAULT_SOURCE@ 1'
actions.update-command: sh -c '[[ $(pactl get-source-mute @DEFAULT_SOURCE@) == *no* ]] && echo true || echo false'

actions.label: Mute
actions.command: sh -c '[[ $SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE == true ]] && pactl set-sink-mute @DEFAULT_SINK@ 0 || pactl set-sink-mute @DEFAULT_SINK@ 1'
actions.update-command: sh -c '[[ $(pactl get-sink-mute @DEFAULT_SINK@) == *no* ]] && echo true || echo false'

actions.label: Night
actions.command: sh -c 'if [[ $SWAYNC_TOGGLE_STATE == true ]]; then killall gammastep 2>/dev/null; gammastep -l 0:0 & else killall gammastep 2>/dev/null; fi'
actions.update-command: sh -c 'pgrep -x gammastep > /dev/null && echo true || echo false'
